hero.subtitle: and I build AI-powered micro apps
hero.description-1: I build micro apps: small web applications focused on solving one specific need and made to be used for real. I use AI as part of my development workflow.
hero.description-2: My most recent projects are Yanashpa Proyectos, a PWA used today to supervise construction work on site, and Marea, a daily emotional journal app. I graduated in Front-end and Back-end Systems Development from IDAT and I'm also a civil engineer, so I know first-hand the problems my apps aim to solve.

items.name: Front-end and Back-end Systems Development - IDAT
items.description: Object-oriented programming with Java, web and mobile development with React and React Native, relational and non-relational databases, web services, design patterns and software quality. Cloud computing with AWS, DevOps with Docker and Jenkins, cybersecurity, secure application development and artificial intelligence. Applied projects integrating the data, business and view layers, built with agile methodologies.

items.name: Oracle Next Education Front-end Program
items.description: Front-end development with React and JavaScript: components, navigation, Styled Components, Hooks and API consumption. HTML, responsive CSS, TypeScript, DOM manipulation and AI integration with ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot. Complemented by training in personal development, agile fundamentals and entrepreneurship.

items.name: Civil Engineering - National University of San Martín
items.description: Bachelor's degree and professional title in Civil Engineering, licensed by the Peruvian College of Engineers (CIP) since 2019. Since 2017 I have worked in technical office, technical project files and construction supervision on road, education, healthcare, sanitation, commercial and housing projects for the public and private sectors.
